property_address_full: Lot 44 (00 Holloway Circle) and Lot 48 (State Park Road), Grand View Hills Subdivision, Greenville, SC 29609 (Paris Mountain Township) — TMS 0498.05-01-044.00 and TMS 0498.05-01-048.00

vesting_paragraph: 407 Brooks Bank, LLC, a South Carolina limited liability company, as to BOTH LOTS 44 AND 48, by Title to Real Estate from Cesar A. Alonso and Yolanda Alonso, dated September 15, 2025 and recorded September 15, 2025 in the Office of the Register of Deeds for Greenville County, South Carolina, in Book 2765 at Page 1735 (Inst. #2025058494).
prior_chain_paragraph: Cesar A. Alonso and Yolanda Alonso acquired Lots 44, 47, and 48 jointly by Title to Real Estate from Juan Velasquez dated and recorded June 24, 2024 in Book 2722 at Page 5340 ($315,000.00); the Alonsos retained Lot 47 (TMS 0498.05-01-047.00) at the time of the September 15, 2025 conveyance to 407 Brooks Bank, LLC, and only Lots 44 and 48 are insured hereunder. Juan Velasquez assembled the three lots over 1976-1982: as to LOT 44, Velasquez acquired by Title to Real Estate from Pink G. Frady, Jr. and Joye C. Frady dated February 9, 1982 and recorded March 1, 1982 in Book 1163 at Page 103 ($2,250.00) — root deed for Lot 44; as to LOT 48, Velasquez acquired by Title to Real Estate from Pink G. Frady, Jr. and Joye C. Frady dated May 14, 1979 and recorded March 19, 1980 in Book 1122 at Page 399 ($3,500.00) — root deed for Lot 48. Both Frady parcels were derived from Murphee C. Donnan deeds at Book 1003 / Page 83 (Lot 44) and Book 1003 / Page 85 (Lot 48). The Grand View Hills Subdivision was platted by R.B. Bruce, R.L.S., dated October 7, 1963 and recorded September 4, 1964 in Plat Book XX at Page 172 (original) and revised by R.B. Bruce dated March 26, 1969 and recorded March 31, 1969 in Plat Book XX at Page 173.
legal_description_paragraphs: LOT 44: ALL that lot of land located in the State of South Carolina, County of Greenville, Paris Mountain Township, near Reid School on the east side of Holloway Circle, and being shown and designated as Lot No. 36 on a plat of Grand View Hills, as shown on Plat recorded in the Office of the Register of Deeds for Greenville County, in Plat Book WWW at Page 52, and shown on a more recent survey and plat by R.B. Bruce, registered surveyor, designated and re-numbered as Lot No. 44, dated October 7, 1963, recorded in Plat Book XX at Page 173, Office of the Register of Deeds for Greenville County, South Carolina. Reference to said more recent plat is being made for a more complete and accurate metes and bounds description as shown thereon. TMS No. 0498.05-01-044.00.

AND ALSO; LOT 48: ALL that piece, parcel and lot of land situated on the west side of State Highway No. 253, near Reid's School, in Paris Mountain Township of Grand View Hills, property of M.C. Donnan according to survey and plat by R.B. Bruce, Registered Surveyor, dated October 7, 1963, recorded in Plat Book XX at Page 173, Office of the Register of Deeds for Greenville County, South Carolina. Reference to said plat is being made for a more complete and accurate metes and bounds description as shown thereon. TMS No. 0498.05-01-048.00.

requirements: The Proposed Insured must notify the Company in writing of the name of any party not referred to in this Commitment who will obtain an interest in the Land or who will make a loan on the Land. The Company may then make additional Requirements or Exceptions.
Pay the agreed amount for the estate or interest to be insured.
Pay the premiums, fees, and charges for the Policy to the Company.

We must be furnished with a copy of SCID 3601 executed pursuant to Section 38-75-960 S.C. Code of Laws 1976, as amended, and an executed Notice of Availability of Title Insurance pursuant to S.C. Code Section 38-75-481, as applicable.

Seller's/Owner's Affidavit Indemnity executed by the current owner of record (407 Brooks Bank, LLC, with mailing address 407 Brooks Bank Court, Simpsonville, SC 29681) on a form to be supplied by the Company stating that there have been no improvements to the Land within the past 90 days which have not been paid for in full, that 407 Brooks Bank, LLC is not a debtor in bankruptcy, and that there are no unrecorded matters which affect the title to either Lot.
Receipt of the acknowledged Title Insurance Company Privacy Policy.
Documents satisfactory to the Company that convey the Title or create the Mortgage to be insured, or both, must be properly authorized, executed, delivered, and recorded in the Public Records.

Evidence satisfactory to the Company of the existence, good standing, and limited liability company authority of 407 Brooks Bank, LLC under the laws of the State of South Carolina, including (a) certified Articles of Organization and any amendments; (b) a current Operating Agreement (or applicable consent of members); (c) Certificate of Existence/Good Standing from the South Carolina Secretary of State dated within 30 days of closing; and (d) a member/manager resolution or written consent specifically authorizing the conveyance and execution of the proposed deed by the named signatory.

Warranty Deed (or General Warranty Deed) from 407 Brooks Bank, LLC, by its duly authorized member or manager, to _____________ conveying the land described in Schedule A herein. Vesting must read exactly: "407 Brooks Bank, LLC."

PAYMENT OF DELINQUENT 2025 AD VALOREM PROPERTY TAXES on BOTH parcels must be confirmed of record prior to or at closing. As of the date of this Commitment, the 2025 Greenville County tax bills on both Lot 44 (Receipt #2025 000012390 77 001, MAP 0498050104400) and Lot 48 (Receipt #2025 000012392 77 001, MAP 0498050104800) are UNPAID, with current balance of $1,419.93 per parcel ($2,839.86 total) reflecting the post-3/16/2026 penalty bracket (5% additional plus $40 cost). The Company will require (a) a paid receipt or bring-down letter from the Greenville County Tax Collector confirming payment in full of all 2025 taxes, fees, and accrued penalties; AND (b) confirmation that no tax-sale advertisement has been published or tax-sale lien filed against either parcel. Failure to clear the delinquent balance prior to closing may result in additional Schedule B-II exception language and/or denial of coverage as to outstanding tax liens.

Notice/affidavit from Insured updating the Greenville County Real Property Services (864-467-7300) and Greenville County Tax Collector (864-467-7050) records to reflect the current owner of record (407 Brooks Bank, LLC, c/o 407 Brooks Bank Court, Simpsonville, SC 29681). The 2025 tax notices were issued in the name of the prior owners (Alonso) at their former mailing address (304 Glinda Ann Ct, Greenville, SC 29607), as the September 15, 2025 conveyance had not yet been processed by the Assessor at the time of bill issuance (12/8/2025).

If the Land is to be insured for amounts in excess of the policy minimum, a current ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey of both Lots may be required at the Company's discretion, particularly to confirm: (i) the metes and bounds of Lot 44 per Plat Book XX/173; (ii) the boundary between Lot 48 and the right-of-way of State Highway 253; (iii) the boundary between Lot 47 (retained by Alonso) and the insured premises; and (iv) confirmation of any encroachments along the shared lot lines.
The Company may make other requirements or exceptions upon its review of the proposed documents creating the estate or interest to be insured or otherwise ascertaining details of the transaction.

This exception is deleted upon issuance of the Policy.

DELINQUENT 2025 AD VALOREM PROPERTY TAXES — Lot 44 (Greenville County Receipt #2025 000012390 77 001, MAP 0498050104400) and Lot 48 (Greenville County Receipt #2025 000012392 77 001, MAP 0498050104800), each carrying an unpaid balance of $1,419.93 (post-3/16/2026 penalty bracket, total $2,839.86 across both parcels), pending payment in full to the Greenville County Tax Collector and a clear bring-down through the date of closing. To be cleared by the Requirements above. Together with taxes and assessments for the year 2026, and subsequent years, not yet due and payable.

Restrictive and Protective Covenants for Grand View Hills (M.C. Donnan, Declarant), dated April 20, 1965 and recorded October 11, 1965 in Book 783 at Page 543, Greenville County Office of the Register of Deeds, applicable to Lots Nos. 1 through 48 inclusive of the subdivision known as Grand View Hills. Includes, without limitation: (i) single-family residential use only; one detached single-family dwelling per lot, plus garage or other outbuildings incidental to residential use; no trailer, tent, shack, garage, or other outbuilding to be used as a residence (temporary or permanent); no shell houses or used houses; (ii) one dwelling per lot; building setback per recorded plat; minimum lot width of 100 feet for frontage if a lot or group of lots is altered or divided; no building nearer than 8 feet to any interior lot line; (iii) minimum 1,400 square feet of ground-floor area, exclusive of open porches and garages; (iv) prohibition on obnoxious or offensive trade, signs, activity, commercial or manufacturing use, and the storage, sale, or advertising of alcoholic beverages; (v) prohibition on horses, cows, hogs, and other domestic livestock (dogs and cats as pets are permitted); and (vi) sewerage by septic per State Board of Health or by municipal sewer where available. Original term ran through December 31, 1985; covenants automatically extend in successive 10-year periods unless changed by majority vote of the then-owners of the lots. PRESENTLY IN FORCE.

Terms, conditions, and provisions of the recorded Grand View Hills subdivision plats, including but not limited to all building setback lines, lot lines, easements (including the 'R/W FOR WATER LINE' shown on the recorded plats), drainage easements, and all other matters shown thereon: (i) Plat Book XX / Page 173 (R.B. Bruce, R.L.S. #1952, revision dated March 26, 1969 and recorded March 31, 1969); (ii) Plat Book XX / Page 172 (R.B. Bruce, R.L.S., original Grand View Hills plat dated October 7, 1963 and recorded September 4, 1964); and (iii) Plat Book WWW / Page 52 (earlier Grand View Hills plat referenced in the Lot 44 description).

Rights of the public and others in and to any portion of the subject premises lying within the bounds of Holloway Circle, State Highway No. 253, or any other public or private right-of-way shown on the recorded plats or otherwise affecting the subject premises.

RETAINED-PARCEL DISCLOSURE — On September 15, 2025, the Alonsos conveyed only Lots 44 and 48 to 407 Brooks Bank, LLC and RETAINED Lot 47 (TMS 0498.05-01-047.00, 3995 State Park Road), which was concurrently held under common ownership at the time of the June 24, 2024 multi-lot acquisition (Bk 2722/5340). The Company makes no representation or insurance with respect to access, drainage, utility lines, or any other appurtenance running between Lots 44/48 and the retained Lot 47. Buyer should confirm existing physical access points, utility lines, and drainage flows independent of the Alonso retained parcel.
